about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Dunn and the towns around it.

reviews.author: NPJosue
reviews.text: Wayne was so helpful. I had bought a wrecked truck at the Copart at Dunn but needed loading assistance since it was totaled. Wayne did more than what needed to be done for a fair price. 10/10

reviews.author: Eileen Pitt
reviews.text: I called for my BF who needed a flat bed due to his car. He was stressed hoping they wouldn’t damage his car. He said everyone was extremely nice. The tow truck driver was patient and worked with him as he helped get his car loaded on the flat bed. The driver showed up fast. Price was way less than our insurance company. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Amra Murphy
reviews.text: They responded to me promptly in the middle of the night with courtesy, respect and wisdom. I was very impressed that Mr Wayne Lee himself came out to respond which is a rarity and today's world that the owner shows up and not only overseas what's going on but took it upon himself to climb under the truck and do what was necessary to get me towed in. Him and his team are top notch and had no problems whatsoever with hauling my company's 26 ft straight truck to the mechanic shop and Hope Mills that my company uses. They even went out of their way to dropped me off at my personal vehicle and then proceeded to take the truck to their yard for the night and then in the morning towed it all the way to Hope Mills to the garage that my company uses. I highly recommend Wayne Lee's Towing and will definitely be using their services again.

reviews.author: Kalmakeisha Kanu
reviews.text: After a stressful happistance (made this word up) I was happy to be assisted by Wayne's Towing. I was surprised by their arrival but it worked in my favor. I called to get rates and the lady who answered stated she would have someone call me back with rates. Instead of calling, they showed up. When I spoke with the gentleman, who quoted me the lowest rate out of all of the companies that I contacted. The man that assisted me was kind and talked me through what he would do and what I needed to do to assist him with patience. Long story short, after the pulling (the man) and the wheel turning (me)....I was out. Woo hoo.

reviews.author: Charles Royal
reviews.text: Great Service! It was Christmas Eve and my wife’s car broke down in Dunn at the most inconvenient time. I called and Randy showed up shortly after my call. He had a smile on his face and worked hard to share it using humor as he worked. He worked quickly, hook up the car, and told a story. I used the story the next day in the pulpit. I’m a preacher. What a treat, a very pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Trevor Maynor
reviews.text: 100% the best towing company I’ve ever dealt with. Wayne was friendly as could be. Responded and worked fast and was a major help.

reviews.author: L Casey
reviews.text: Wayne Lee's Towing was fantastic! I am from out of state and my vehicle broke down just off I 95 on a Sunday. I am covered by US Rider Insurance (they also are fantastic!) Wayne Lee's found a wonderful hotel for myself and my little dog, dropped us off, towed my vehicle to the shop, and had it repaired by 11:30 the next day. (wheel bearing assembly), Picked us up and brought us to the shop to get the vehicle.

reviews.author: Julie Pruitt
reviews.text: Broke down today and had my truck towed by Bradley absolutely the best!! Thank you for your great service will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: Brian McFaden
reviews.text: Had part of my tail pipe come loose on 95 south and I didn't have the tools to remove the clamps. These guys came out quickly and took great care of me. Mobile service calls are expensive ($150) but probably the norm for this area.

reviews.author: Wanda Gautier
reviews.text: Wayne Lees Towing does all my inspections services. I have been going to Wayne Lee’s for 10 + years and they do my oil changes, all fluid changes and inspections on all necessary inspections on my auto and they are fast, and converted with myself on anything prior to taking action. I highly recommend Wayne Lees Towing & Wrecker Services.

reviews.author: Paul Bennis
reviews.text: Most helpful towing service I've ever dealt with. I've never seen someone go above and beyond to help a customer. I was almost 400 miles away from home in an emergency situation, and these guys took the time to hear my problem and help me through to a solution. They genuinely care. Their Google ratings were why I called them to begin with, and I can see why it's so high. Thanks a lot, Wayne!

reviews.author: Amanda Wood
reviews.text: I went to get my car inspected here. They were great! They were very friendly and on point. I would recommend them to anyone and will go again. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: David Lang
reviews.text: Went here for inspection. Lived in Dunn for 7 years 3 blocks from this station. Always get my inspections from Four Oaks. Called wayne ahead of time to ask for price and he wouldn’t give me one over phone. Went in person and asked again for price young man said 13.00. They pulled car in and inspected it. When fiinished wayne said 23.00. I asked why 23$ and he said tint. I explained that I am local and wanted to start doing business in my community. He looked at next in line and said are you ready for your inspection? The extra 10$ was for tint which he never tested I was watching the whole time. We are in our 50s and have just enough tint to help with sun you can look at it easily and tell. Four oaks has never charged me this. Windows have been done 10 years. I feel I have 20 years of driving left easily. 4 vehicles x13.00 =52$ x20 years =1040$. Not a smart transaction Mr Lee. I will keep my business in four oaks. Even tipped him 2$ made it an even 25 Just so you remember who I am.

reviews.author: Ivan Wood
reviews.text: Went to get an inspection sticker. The boy that did it gets it in, hooked up his machine and then came outside and said my engine light was on. My light had never been on until he hooked his machine to my vehicle. They failed my vehicle but still charged me almost the full price of the inspection. Never went back and never will. Took it to another inspection station and did not have a problem with passing it.

reviews.author: Kari Johnson
reviews.text: They were the only tow company that would come out for me at 1 am on a Monday evening. He was so nice helping me figure out my next steps with my insurance /car company /rental car etc. was the only people who would drive me and my dog to a hotel. A real life saver when it’s storming , there’s no ubers or lyfts at all in the area and the sherrif n other tows can help. I would recommend Wayne Lee’s towing over and over. Very sweet,trustworthy people . Was knowledgeable and able to properly tow my Tesla thank god

reviews.author: Cathy Halliwell
reviews.text: Wayne Lee's towing was wonderful! Two other companies that Mercedes sent were unable to assist me with my 170" extended high roof sprinter van. They stuck with it, returning multiple times, to ensure I could get my van back to Richmond, VA! They ended up towing it twice...once to move it out of the way for a business that did not like it in their lot, and a second time to get it on to the hauler that brought it back to me. Thank you Wayne Lee's for not giving up on me!

reviews.author: Chelsy L
reviews.text: Friendly service, was able to get all my belongings from my car after being towed due to an accident. I noticed they are a full service station that pumps gas for you still and has a small repair shop.

reviews.author: Alexis Semanchuk
reviews.text: I was visiting from out of town and on the day I was driving back to NY I could not get my grandson's carseat out of my car. Having no idea who could help me I went to Wayne Lee's because it was nearby and my daughter gets her car inspected there. The gentleman was so helpful and neighborly, I am so grateful to them.

reviews.author: Henry Yale
reviews.text: These folks are amazing. No matter who you talk to from the nice lady sam, or any of the drivers. They are all just amazing caring folks. I highly recommend them to anyone I talk to

reviews.author: Joseph Byrd
reviews.text: They have a tow truck for every need. Answers the phone quickly, great customer service, family owned and operated. Hey also so my vehicle inspections. Great family owned business.

reviews.author: Judy Glover
reviews.text: Bent over backwards to help us move our 5th wheel after our tow vehicle was disabled. They were on time. And scheduled us right away. Very professional. Wished I had called them 1sr!

reviews.author: Brandon Preston
reviews.text: Got my truck and trailer towed to the dealership yesterday. Awesome service and very professional. Thanks again to Dustin, much appreciated

reviews.author: James Franey
reviews.text: Truly 24hr towing. Always professional and courteous prompt and damage free towing. I can see why they have been in business over 50 years and 3 generations on staff.

reviews.author: Lauren Weathers
reviews.text: Dustin was great to work with and very knowledgeable. He took care of towing my car to the dealership very quickly.

reviews.author: Majestic Slayer
reviews.text: Very professional. Fast response time. All around great experience. I would definitely recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Kenneth r Kimber jr
reviews.text: This is a wonderful wrecker service and far price.they treated me well.i will called them again if I need help.

reviews.author: hannah_artt
reviews.text: They let my car be taken without a verbal or written realse from me. So they essentially let my car be stolen. A careless mistake on their part.

reviews.author: Shanna Smith
reviews.text: Called them at 5am on a Saturday morning and they quickly got out to get my daughter and her friend off the side of 95. THANK YOU!
